description: This file defines a public enum 'PhotoCapture' with a static method 'transcodeJPEGForGateway' that transcodes raw image data into JPEG format suitable for gateway transmission, considering payload size and quality constraints.

methods.name: transcodeJPEGForGateway
methods.description: Transcodes raw image data into JPEG format with specified maximum width and quality, ensuring the payload stays within size limits for gateway transfer.
